rv.q: McCollum’s performance is among the most spectacular to be experienced currently on the New York stage.
Make Me Gorgeous arrives entertaining, illuminating, and moving; Marlowe herself eminently appealing.
McCollum’s performance keeps the action taut and consistently shines a bright light on a remarkable life.
His personal charm and rapport with the audience also makes this a pleasurable experience.
Singing, stripping, and hilariously vamping an unsuspecting male in the audience, McCollum is the hardest-working woman in show business.
This one-person show is a joyful and smart engagement, filled with captivating feather moves and high kicks that fly out like a handful of birdseed turmoil sprung out of captivity in the back.

cn.t: Wade McCollum delivers a stunning, tour-de-force performance bringing forgotten LGBTQ pioneer Kenneth/Kate Marlowe vividly to life in this engaging solo show that resurrects a remarkable, wildly checkered life story.
